birthDate.note: Wikidata and Tennis Explorer both give 25 April 1990. The ATP semi-final report says he is 34, but the ATP preview of 28 Oct 2026 says 36, which matches this date. The ATP player bio page was not usable (it renders another player).

nationality.note: Wikidata gives Germany as country of citizenship. Laver Cup lists his country as GER.
